team.name: Emmanuel Evbuomwan
team.expertise: Programme & Project Management · Financial Management & Budgeting · NGO Management & Institutional Development
team.bio:
Emmanuel Evbuomwan is a Development Practitioner and NGO Management Professional with core expertise in Programme and Project Management, Financial Management and Budgeting, and NGO Management and Institutional Development.

He brings experience in development programme coordination, project planning and implementation, budget preparation and monitoring, financial accountability, resource mobilisation, donor engagement and organisational strengthening.

His professional approach integrates effective programme delivery, sound financial management and institutional capacity development to promote accountability, operational efficiency and sustainable development outcomes.

He is passionate about strengthening organisations, improving development systems and ensuring that resources translate into measurable and lasting social impact. He is also the Co-Founder of RhemRoyal Consultancy Services.

team.name: Omondiagbe George Osamu
team.expertise: Research Analyst · Project Management · Legal Consultant
team.bio:
Omondiagbe George Osamu is a social development practitioner and professional NGO consultant.

Omondiagbe possesses over a decade of experience in NGO development, research, project execution, monitoring, evaluation and intervention programming.

His professional approach underscores effectiveness, efficiency, transparency and capacity to deliver project goals within project time frame.

His essence is strengthening young organisations, improving development strategies and ensuring compliance for lasting project impact.

He is the founder of OMO-GREJ International Nigeria Limited and also a Co-Founder of RhemRoyal Consultancy Services.
